seed.description: The default seed. A procedural source's `Procedural.seed` wins over it.

layout.description:
Where the editor's node canvas draws each node, `[x, y]` by node id
(ADR-0044). Only nodes that were moved have an entry. Layout is not
part of a node: generation, node cache keys, the document hash and the
version stamp all ignore it. Omitted when empty.

version.description: The node type's version (for migrating parameters).

params.description: The node's parameters, in file order; checked by the node type.

size.description: Samples per side (2 to 2049). The field is centred on the source.

scale.description: Noise frequency: noise units per metre (smaller is broader).

height.description: Height of the highest possible point, in metres (heights run from 0 to this).

warp.description: Warp strength in noise units (`warped` only).

offset.description: Moves the noise pattern, in metres `[x, z]`.

size.description:
Samples per side (2 to 2049). `field.combine` resamples it to the
other field's size, so it rarely needs changing.

radius.description:
The island's radius as a fraction of the half extent (1 reaches the
middle of each edge).

falloff.description: The fraction of the radius over which the mask falls from 1 to 0.

collider.description: Also add a heightfield `Collider` built from the same samples.

max_level.description:
The coarsest level of detail (0 to 8): root tiles are 64 × 2^max_level
samples of the field's spacing.

name.description: The entity's name when the graph is not streamed.

size.description: The side length of the square plane, in metres.

subdivisions.description: Cells per side of the plane mesh (1 to 1024).

spacing.description:
Metres between the samples erosion runs on, when streamed (the
field's own spacing otherwise).

droplets.description: Droplets per cell of the erosion grid.

steps.description: Steps a droplet lives at most.

erosion.description: Share of the free capacity eroded per step (0 to 1).

deposition.description: Share of the excess sediment dropped per step (0 to 1).

capacity.description: Sediment a droplet can carry, per unit of slope, speed and water.

t.description: The blend factor of `lerp` (0 gives `a`, 1 gives `b`).

points.description: `curve`: at least two `[in, out]` points with increasing `in`.

smooth.description: `terrace`: 0 for sharp steps, up to 1 for a smooth ramp.

radius.description: The smallest distance between two points, in metres.

attempts.description: Candidates tried around each point before it is retired (Bridson's `k`).

extent.description: The side of the square to fill when no field is connected, in metres.

slope_min.description: Drop points flatter than this slope (rise over run: 0 is flat, 1 is 45°).

slope_max.description: Drop points steeper than this slope (rise over run).

spacing.description: Distance between grid cells, in metres.

jitter.description:
How far each point may move from its cell's centre, as a fraction of
the spacing (0 is a regular grid, 1 fills the cell).

extent.description: The side of the square to fill when no field is connected, in metres.

slope_min.description: Drop points flatter than this slope (rise over run: 0 is flat, 1 is 45°).

slope_max.description: Drop points steeper than this slope (rise over run).

slope_min.description: Drop points flatter than this slope (rise over run: 0 is flat, 1 is 45°).

slope_max.description: Drop points steeper than this slope (rise over run).

mask_min.description: With a `mask` field connected: drop points where the mask is below this.

density.description:
Keep each point with this probability (decided per point id, so the
same points survive whatever else changes).

choices.description: The choices; each point picks one at random by weight.

prefab.description:
The prefab placed at untagged points (or at every point when
`prefabs` is empty), relative to the project root.

prefabs.description:
A prefab per tag (from `points.pick`); points whose tag has none and
that `prefab` does not cover are skipped.

random_yaw.description: Turn each instance about Y by a random angle.

align_to_normal.description: Tilt each instance so its +Y follows the surface normal.

offset_y.description: Raise (or sink) each instance by this many metres.

name.description: The instance entities' name; the prefab file's name when empty.

size.description: `box`: the full size `[x, y, z]`; `plane`: `[x, _, z]`.

height.description: `cylinder`: the full height; `capsule`: the length of the straight part.

rings.description: Rings: pole to pole for a sphere, per end for a capsule.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied X, then Y, then Z.

material.description:
A material file, relative to the project root
(`materials/stone.material.json`); `re_app` loads it through `re_assets`.

group.description:
When set, a group entity `<node>/group` with this name is created and
every entity of the inputs without a parent goes under it.

points.description:
The outer contour, `[x, z]` in metres (3 points or more, either
direction).

holes.description: Holes inside it, each 3 points or more.

distance.description: Metres to grow the shapes by (negative shrinks them).

height.description: The height of the flat mesh, in metres.

size.description: Samples per side when no `field` is connected (2 to 4097).

cell.description: Metres between samples when no `field` is connected.

falloff.description:
Outside the shapes, the mask falls from 1 to 0 over this many metres
(0 for a hard edge).

points.description:
The control points (2 or more; 3 or more when `closed`). With a
`field` connected, each point's `y` is added to the field's height
under it.

width.description: The road's width in metres, where a point does not set one.

bank.description:
The bank in degrees, where a point does not set one; positive raises
the left edge.

spacing.description: Metres between samples along the centreline.

closed.description: Joins the last point back to the first.

junction_radius.description:
Roads are cut back this far (metres) around a junction, and the
junction surface fills the disc (0 for no junctions).

snap.description: A road end this close (metres) to another road makes a junction.

bank_fade.description:
Over this distance (metres) before a junction, the bank fades to 0
and the road eases to the junction's height.

margin.description:
Metres to grow the footprint by on each side (for a verge, or to
keep scattered props off the road).

shoulder.description: Flat ground kept on each side beyond the road's edge, in metres.

blend.description:
Past the shoulder, the ground blends back to the field over this many
metres.

depth.description:
The flattened ground sits this far below the road's centreline, so
the road surface is drawn above it.

size.description: The full size `[x, y, z]`, in metres (each 0.001 to 10000).

radius.description:
The radius of the rounded edges and corners, from 0 (six flat quads)
to half the smallest side.

segments.description: Steps per quarter circle of a rounded edge: an even number, 2 to 64.

subdivisions.description:
How many times each triangle is split in four (0 to 6): 20 × 4^n
triangles.

radius.description:
The radius at the bottom, in metres (0 to 10000; 0 is a point, but not
at both ends).

top_radius.description:
The radius at the top, in metres (0 to 10000): 0 for a cone, the
bottom radius for a cylinder.

caps.description: Closes the ends with flat faces.

radius.description:
The radius of the circle the tube follows, in metres (0.001 to 10000,
larger than `tube`).

tube.description:
The radius of the tube, in metres (0.001 to 10000, smaller than
`radius`).

width.description: The width along X, in metres (0.001 to 10000).

rise.description: The height of each step, in metres (0.001 to 10000).

run.description: The depth of each step, in metres (0.001 to 10000).

span.description: The width of the opening at its feet, in metres (0.001 to 10000).

rise.description:
The height of the opening, in metres (0.001 to 10000, at most half
the span: a semicircle).

thickness.description: The thickness of the ring, in metres (0.001 to 10000).

depth.description: The depth along Z, in metres (0.001 to 10000).

translation.description: Moves the mesh, in metres (each -1000000 to 1000000).

rotation.description:
Euler angles in degrees, applied X, then Y, then Z (each -1000000 to
1000000).

scale.description:
Scale per axis, applied first (each -1000000 to 1000000, not 0); an
odd number of negative axes mirrors the mesh.

axis.description: The axis the mirror plane is square to.

offset.description: Where the plane crosses the axis, in metres (-1000000 to 1000000).

keep.description:
Keeps the original too, joined to its reflection at the points on the
plane (faces lying on the plane go); else only the reflection.

distance.description:
Points closer than this merge, in metres (0 to 1000; 0 merges only
points at the same position).

group.description: The face group to turn around; empty for every face.

name.description: The group to write, replacing a group of that name.

direction.description: `direction`: the direction faces should face (not zero).

angle.description:
`direction`: the largest angle between a face's normal and
`direction`, in degrees (0 to 180).

min.description: `box`: the box's lowest corner, in metres.

max.description: `box`: the box's highest corner, in metres.

material.description: `material`: the material file, as `poly.material` set it.

end.description:
`index`: one past the last face chosen (faces past the mesh's last are
ignored).

fraction.description: `random`: the probability that a face is chosen (0 to 1).

group.description: The face group to paint; empty for every face.

material.description:
A material file, relative to the project root
(`materials/stone.material.json`); empty for the default material.

domain.description: What the attribute has one value per.

name.description:
The attribute's name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with
a letter (`color` is the vertex colour). Not `material`, which
`poly.material` sets.

type.description:
The type of the values; when omitted, a number is a `float`, `true`
or `false` a `bool`, and a list of 2, 3 or 4 numbers a `vec2`, `vec3`
or `vec4`.

value.description: The value given to every element of the group's faces.

group.description:
The face group whose faces (or their corners or points) get the
value; empty for every face.

material.description:
Only the faces drawn with this material file; empty for every face,
drawn with the first material any face uses.

EdgeDoc.description:
An edge from an output port to an input port.

Each end is `(node id, port)`, written as a two-element array.

from.description: The source node and output port.

to.description: The destination node and input port.

oneOf.description: Map `[in_min, in_max]` linearly onto `[out_min, out_max]` (not clamped).

A piecewise-linear curve through `points` (`[[in, out], …]`, sorted by
`in`; flat beyond the ends).
Steps `step` metres high; `smooth` is the fraction of each step that ramps.

tag.description: The tag given to the points that pick this choice.

oneOf.description: A capsule of `radius` whose straight part is `height` long.
A flat plane of `size[0]` by `size[2]`, facing +Y.
Area in exactly one of them.
A sharp corner (bevelled when very sharp).

path.spline.PointDoc.description:
A control point of `path.spline`: `[x, y, z]`, or an object that can
also set the width and bank there.

anyOf.description: A position `[x, y, z]` in metres.
A position with its own width or bank.

width.description: The road's width here (default: the node's `width`).

bank.description: The bank here in degrees (default: the node's `bank`).

oneOf.description: Faces whose normal is within `angle` degrees of `direction`.

Faces whose centre (the average of their corners) is inside the box
from `min` to `max`, edges included.
Faces drawn with `material` (empty: the default material).
Each face with probability `fraction`, from the node's seed.

poly.attribute.DomainParam.description: What an attribute has one value per.

oneOf.description: Each point the group's faces use.
Each corner of the group's faces.

poly.attribute.TypeParam.description: The type of an attribute's values.

oneOf.description: A rotation as a quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`, normalised.

poly.attribute.Constant.description:
A constant attribute value: a number, `true` or `false`, or a list of
two to four numbers.
